name: Synology DSM
notes: DSM answers plain HTTP on 5000 and HTTPS on 5001; this uses 5000 and leaves the encryption to this node. If DSM is set to redirect HTTP to HTTPS by itself, switch that off or use https://...:5001 as the target, or visitors are sent on to port 5001. The expected status is empty because what / answers depends on that setting. Uploads through File Station are what the timeout is for.
